name: Custom single-target Intellect buffs are exclusive-highest with Arcane Intellect and each other (#10710)
contract: Maintainer decision for #10710: Celestial Mind (Starcaller 300255 chain, Greater 680301), Nozdormu's Wisdom
(Chronomancer 572391 chain, Greater 572396), Call of the Storm (Stormbringer 578311 chain, Greater 578316) and
Seal of Alysrazor (Pyromancer 800196 chain, Greater 570170) join the vanilla Single Intellect Buffs group 1083
(SPELL_GROUP_STACK_RULE_EXCLUSIVE_HIGHEST) as one subgroup per family. Spell.dbc SPELL_AURA_MOD_STAT Intellect
values (BasePoints + 1): Arcane Intellect rank 3 (1461) 15, Celestial Mind rank 5 (301225) 31, Nozdormu's
Wisdom rank 4 (572394) 25 and rank 5 (572395) 31. Native behaviour: a weaker buff is refused at cast
(Spell::CheckCast -> IsHighestExclusiveAuraEffect, SPELL_FAILED_AURA_BOUNCED); a stronger or equal one is
applied and Aura::CanStackWith removes the other. So Celestial Mind replaces Arcane Intellect (+31, not
+46), a later Arcane Intellect rank 3 and Nozdormu's Wisdom rank 4 bounce, and Nozdormu's Wisdom rank 5
replaces the equal Celestial Mind. Control: Chromie's Wisdom (801523, Spirit) is outside group 1083 and keeps
the self-scoped 'Only one Wisdom per Chronomancer' rule (group 1135): it replaces the same Chronomancer's
Nozdormu's Wisdom and then coexists with another class's Arcane Intellect.
